messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-98321: inference-queue.depth > 2000 (5m avg) in us-west1-cell-3. severity=P1. runbook: /runbooks/inference-queue.md :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page triggered and routed to #eng-oncall. escalation policy: inference-oncall.

alice_oncall: ack — I'm on it, pulling logs + metrics now.

alice_oncall: quick snapshot: queue size 2.1k -> 3.4k over last 10m. p95 latency 1200ms -> 3s. 502 errors increasing.

bob_sre: joining. which autoscaler? hpa or scale-controller? any quota errors in node events?

alice_oncall: scale-controller (custom autoscaler). events: "failed to provision nodes: quota exceeded" and repeated API 403s to cloud provider. HPA not the limiter.

dylan_eng: is impact cross-region or isolated to that cell?

alice_oncall: isolated to us-west1 cell-3. cell-1 looks healthy.

carla_support: FYI support seeing several customer timeouts, ticket #7892. I'll draft a customer-facing note saying we're mitigating.

bob_sre: short term options: 1) manual nodepool scale if quota allows, 2) traffic failover to cell-1, 3) route to compatible lower-memory model variant to reduce per-request footprint.

dylan_eng: we have a fallback variant (fallback-model-v2) compatible with most requests. quality slightly lower but better than timeouts.

alice_oncall: starting traffic reroute to fallback-model-v2 in cell-1. applying policy: set route weight ~30% to cell-1 fallback.

incident-bot: Action log: traffic-reroute executed by alice_oncall at 4371234580 — route weights adjusted (cell-3:70% -> cell-1:30%).

alice_oncall: manual nodepool scale requested: +10 GPU nodes to shared-pool via cloud-provision ticket #452. ETA 8-12 minutes. Cloud API returned "quota request submitted".

dylan_eng: can we reduce per-request timeout to reduce backlog? a lower timeout will free up workers faster and fail fast for queuing clients.

alice_oncall: bumped /generate timeout from 60s -> 30s via routing config. command used: ```curl -X PATCH https://config.service/routes/inference -d '{"timeout_ms":30000}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"```

bob_sre: monitoring: after reroute + timeout bump queue trending down: 3.4k -> 1.8k over 6 minutes. 502 error rate stabilizing.

carla_support: customer note prepared and sent to affected customers. referencing INC-98321 and estimated recovery ETA 15m.

alice_oncall: handing off live monitoring + warm-up validation to bob_sre. I'll track cloud-provision and close ticket when nodes are up. Bob, you own for next hour.

bob_sre: ack takeover. I'll keep PD incident open until autoscaler fully recovers and queue < 200 for 10m.

eva_product: product notice: derived metrics show a 6% drop in success rate for generation tasks in the window. add to postmortem please.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-98321 acknowledged by bob_sre.

incident-bot: Incident status update: partial mitigation achieved (traffic reroute + timeout bump). Node provisioning in progress. Next steps: verify autoscaler recovery, reconcile quota alerting. Postmortem assigned to alice_oncall + dylan_eng.

alice_oncall: noted. I'll open a follow-up doc with timeline + detection gap (quota alerts didn't surface early).

bob_sre: monitoring looks stable. keeping incident open until cloud nodes ready and autoscaler resumes normal provisioning. will update every 5m.

alice_oncall: stepping off the thread to chase cloud ticket. thanks all.
